events.title: Doubling Horde
events.description: All future nights spawn twice as many enemies.
omens: Your wish is your destiny.
The road grows teeth behind you.
Every shadow learns to walk twice.
A thousand footsteps answer one prayer.

events.title: Second Core
events.description: A new core appears in a random open area. Losing any core ends the run.
omens: The heart divides and calls it mercy.
A second pulse wakes under cold stone.
One throne was never enough.
The mirror keeps breathing.

events.title: Gold Tithe
events.description: Lose half of your current gold.
omens: The coin remembers its first owner.
Half the sun is owed below.
Your purse kneels before the dark.
Silver leaves by the door it entered.

events.title: Broken Walls
events.description: Half of all walls are destroyed at random.
omens: Stone dreams of being dust.
The mortar forgets its vows.
A wall is only a delayed apology.
The old teeth loosen in the jaw.

events.title: Blood Price
events.description: Skip the next night and gain its dawn gold, but all friendly troops die.
omens: The quiet comes hungry.
A saved hour asks for names.
Peace arrives wearing borrowed faces.
The bell does not ring for the living.
